items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I played with Joe Williams — he got his first Grammy, in fact I was the band leader on that session.

ctx.x: And how, let me tell you. I don’t know if you’re familiar, well I’m sure you’re probably familiar with Willie Dixon and well he used to write a lot of songs. He had a trio called

the Big Three Trio because all three of them weighed about 300 pounds or more apiece. And I knew him very well. In fact when he went with Cobra Records myself and Hal Ashby was his favorite saxophone players. In fact I just picked up a re-issue of the Cobra label things that was done during that era during the 50s of Cobra Records. And I got a lot of CDs that Hal Ashby and myself were on with Willie Dixon. And of course Willie Dixon used to write a lot of stuff for Muddy Waters and Koko Taylor. And I played with…
In other words, it don’t mean a thing —
